title: Pool in 5 Points Hip East Nash - close to DT!
description:
Brand new plunge pool in the center of one of the most eclectic & sought after  neighborhoods in Nashville ~ step out your door into the heart of 5 Points East Nashville & walk to some of the cities finest eateries & watering holes!  Country Music and Sports fans welcome, only 1 mile from Nissan Stadium & 1.5 miles to the Country Music Hall of Fame & Broadway Honky Tonks. Come home to a refreshing dip in the pool & relaxation on our 2 decks & spacious backyard before heading back on the town.

The space
If you love to hang outside you'll love our grassy backyard and brand new 2nd deck & plunge pool!  Our remodeled 1000 square foot home has all the basic comforts of home ​​​​​​​in a hip walkable neighborhoods with an eclectic atmosphere.   With 30 restaurants/bars within a 3 block walk from our house and countless more within a half mile, not to mention locally owned boutique shopping, you'll have plenty to explore!!   Front door opens to a large open floor plan living room and kitchen that leads out onto the spacious deck overlooking our large backyard and stairs down to a 2nd large deck and 3' deep 8'X16' plunge pool, perfect for cooling off and sunning on those warm Nashville days.  Pool has locking gates at deck entrances to protect your little ones! Also a great place to sit and hear the live bands playing from Drifters and relax after a day or evening out on the town!  Master bedroom has a smart TV and en-suite bathroom complete with jetted tub and separate shower.  There is a second full bedroom and full bathroom with shower/tub combo across the hall.  A tankless water heater ensures enough hot water for everyone in your group!   Backyard has privacy fence with remote opening gate so we can offer gated off street parking as well as parking passes for out front!   The living room is outfitted with a full sofa sleeper,  60" TV, smart DVD player and Netflix (no cable).  Bring your family or friends and come enjoy fantastic 5 Points!  

This private home has an empty basement apartment that is not included - if interested in renting entire home (3 bed / 3 bath) enquire for that listing

One pool towel per guest will be available, do not take white shower towels outside or use at the pool.

Guest access
Full access to the front yard, main floor of the home and the large back deck.  Basement apartment may be rented as well to fit larger groups - entire home is under a separate listing so please inquire if you are interested in the whole house.

Other things to note
This is the full upstairs home that has a separate basement apartment that is not include in this specific listing.  Please be as respectful and courteous as possible to our lovely neighbors.  We all love to be outside, if it's nice out it's possible you will see us out and about working on the yard or exploring the neighborhood.
